sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Volskaya Foundry is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Overwatch universe.
The signature Objective of this Map is a Capture Point that
rewards a Triglav Protector. The team who wins the Objective can pilot
the Triglav Protector, a massive Vehicle with 2 seats that can be used
to deal damage to enemy Structures and to Shield allied Heroes.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text:
Prefer
Strong late game
Siege damage for Structures
Sustain damage/healing
Avoid
Effects relying on bushes
Effects relying on impassable terrain
Weak late game
See our Volskaya Foundry Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text:
Here you can find one or more formations
that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane
are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 4-1
Map Strategy
sections.text:
At 0:30 minutes or whenever available, start clearing the allied Fortification Camp
and capture it as soon as possible. Do not forget to pick up the Turret!
If you are quick enough, you can get a second Turret
at the beginning of the first Objective phase.
Ideally, you should capture this Mercenary Camp even during the Objective phase.
After that, whenever your team has an advantage
or you believe that the enemy team is still busy clearing the enemy Fortification Camp,
you can capture the neutral Support Camp near the top lane.
Do not forget to pick the Biotic Emitter!
At 2:15 minutes or 30-40 seconds before the next Objective phase, start clearing
the allied Siege Camp and capture it slightly before the Capture Point activates.
To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions,
capture it at 2:40 minutes or 10 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned.
At 3:00 minutes or whenever the Objective phase starts, make sure to have
a durable Hero on the Capture Point. Keep control of it for as much as possible
without dying and retreat if needed. Then, whenever your team gets
an advantage, try to push out enemy Heroes
and win the Objective. In the early game,
the Offlaner should keep soaking.
If your team wins the Objective, the first Triglav Protector of the game
should preferably be used to destroy Structures in the top lane (in preparation
for the second Objective phase), the second one should be used to destroy
a Fort, and the following ones should be used to destroy a Keep
and eventually go Core. In the early game,
the Offlaner should keep soaking.
If your team loses the Objective, you can either deal damage to the
Triglav Protector or dive past it to kill
squishy enemy Heroes. In the early game,
the Offlaner should keep soaking.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text:
As shown in the image below, Volskaya Foundry has a total of 5 Mercenary Camps:
2 Siege Camps (green icon) in the top lane;
1 Support Camp (red icon) between the top and the middle lanes;
2 Fortification Camps (purple icon) between the middle and bottom lanes.
Mercenary Camps on Volskaya Foundry disappear from the battlefield
once the Triglav Protector has been spawned (unless their Mercenaries
are in combat) and reappear only after the Triglav Protector has been killed.

Mercenary Camps indicated with a red icon are immune to Bribe effects.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Assault Troopers. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
3:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
270 Experience
+6 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Assault Troopers are ranged units that can attack enemies from the distance but lack
area of effect damage to quickly clear enemy Minions.
Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range.

sections.title: Fortification Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Mechanic and 1 Turret. Once captured,
it leaves a Turret on the ground that can be collected by allied or enemy Heroes.
Always kill the Mechanic first because he can repair the Turret while below 80% Health.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
2:30 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
460 Experience
+10 Experience per minute

sections.title: Turret
sections.text:
Turrets are consumable items that, when put on the ground, deal damage to an
enemy within range, prioritizing Heroes and dealing double damage to Minions.
Since they count as Mercenaries, you can empower them with some Talents
(such as Mercenary Queen by Sylvanas)
and weaken them with some other Talents (for example
Amateur Opponent by Artanis).
Turret
[F]
Item
Place a Turret that rapidly attacks
nearby enemies for 45 (+2 per minute) damage every 0.5 seconds.
Turret lasts for 45 seconds, or until destroyed.

sections.title: Support Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Support Mech. Once captured, it leaves
a Biotic Emitter on the ground that can be collected by allied or enemy Heroes.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
3:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
625 Experience
+10 Experience per minute
Due to being Elite, this Mercenary Camp is immune to Bribe
effects (such as Covert Mission by Nova).

sections.title: Biotic Emitter
sections.text:
Biotic Emitters are consumable items that, when put on the ground, restore
Health and Mana of allied Heroes in range. Do not position them too forward,
otherwise they will quickly get destroyed by enemy Heroes.
Biotic Emitter
[F]
Item
Create a Biotic Emitter that restores
40% of nearby allied Heroes' maximum Health and Mana.
Biotic Emitter lasts for 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective on Volskaya Foundry is a Capture Point that rewards
a Triglav Protector to the team who gets 100% progress first.
The winners can pilot the Triglav Protector, a massive Vehicle with 2 seats that can be used
to deal damage to enemy Structures and to Shield allied Heroes.
Vehicles are Unstoppable.
Capture Points will activate 3 seconds after a Hero steps on them, then they will
give 2% per second over 45 seconds, pausing when abandoned for more than 12 seconds,
and not giving the final reward if contested.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
3:00 minutes
3:00 minutes after the Triglav Protector dies

Capture Points
Control points activate occasionally. Stand within them to capture them. Fully capturing a point grants you control of a giant mech.
Control the Protector
The Triglav Protector mech is controlled by two players: one pilot and one gunner. Work together!
Destroy Everything
The Protector's abilities deal incredible damage to structures and Heroes alike. Use it to lay waste to your enemy.
Once claimed, the Triglav Protector lasts for 50 seconds plus 3 seconds for each
minute of Game Time that has passed. Each of the 2 players controlling the Triglav Protector
has access to a different set of Abilities (similarly to Cho'Gall)
and can decide to exit whenever they want, allowing someone else to enter in their place.
The pilot's Basic Attacks deals 100% more damage to enemy Structures.
While both seats are occupied, the pilot's Basic Attacks deal 50% more damage
and both the pilot's and gunner's Abilities
recharge 25% faster and Energy regeneration is increased by 25%.
The first player to enter in the Triglav Protector
will become the pilot, able to decide where to go, whereas the second one will become the gunner.
If only the gunner seat is already taken (because the previous pilot decided to exit)
then the next player entering in the Triglav Protector will become the pilot.

sections.title: Triglav Pilot
sections.text:
The following Abilities can be used by the player who is in the Triglav Protector's pilot seat.
Whoever enters first in a newly spawned Triglav Protector will be the pilot.

sections.title: Charge
sections.text:
Charge
[Q]
Pilot
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Charge a target and deal 160 (+14 per minute) damage in an area.
Non-Heroes take 500% increased damage.
Charge should ideally be used to damage enemy Structures
because it deals way more damage to non-Heroes or
to clear enemy Minions because it can hit many of them,
resulting in more damage per cast compared to hitting a single target.
Charge should ideally NOT be used on Heroes because it deals way less damage to them.

sections.title: Rocket Fist
sections.text:
Rocket Fist
[W]
Pilot
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Launch a Rocket Fist that deals 150 (+15 per minute) damage
to the first Hero or Structure in its path. The rocket pushes away Heroes for 1.5
seconds and disables Structures for 4 seconds. Minions on its path are instantly killed.
Rocket Fist should ideally be used to instantly kill enemy Minions
and/or to disable enemy Structures that are attacking someone.
Avoid overlapping Shield Emitter to take less damage from enemy
Structures and Rocket Fist to disable enemy Structures.
In case of emergency, Rocket Fist [W] can be also used to peel
for your team, or to interrupt a powerful
stationary channeled Ability.
(such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.).

sections.title: Shield Emitter
sections.text:
Shield Emitter
[E]
Pilot
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds and give
nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 500 (+50 per minute) damage over 3 seconds.
Shield Emitter should be used to save allied Heroes from incoming damage
and/or to reduce damage taken by the Triglav Protector, especially when
in range of enemy Structures that are not disabled by Rocket Fist.
Avoid overlapping Shield Emitter to take less damage from enemy
Structures and Rocket Fist to disable enemy Structures.

sections.title: Triglav Gunner
sections.text:
The following Abilities can be used by the player that is in the Triglav Protector's gunner seat.
Whoever enters second in a newly spawned Triglav Protector will be the gunner.

sections.title: Particle Cannon
sections.text:
Particle Cannon
[Q]
Gunner
Cooldown: 4 seconds
Start extending the range of the Particle Cannon.
Reactivate to fire, dealing 190 (+19 per minute) damage in the targe area.
Particle Cannon should ideally be used to clear enemy Minions because it can hit many of them,
resulting in more damage per cast compared to hitting a single target.

sections.title: Gatling Cannon
sections.text:
Gatling Cannon
[W]
Gunner
Toggle to fire missiles at the cursor's location.
Each missile deals 38 (+3.8 per minute) damage but drains 1 Energy. Reactivate
to stop firing. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.
Gatling Cannon should ideally be used to hit enemy Heroes
because it deals 50% less damage to enemy Structures.
To maximize cooldown usage, you should stop using Gatling Cannon
when Particle Cannon and Scorching Laser are ready to use again.
To maximize Energy usage, you should be using Gatling Cannon
when having maximum Energy or close to maximum Energy.

sections.title: Scorching Laser
sections.text:
Scorching Laser
[E]
Gunner
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Vector Targeting
Draw a line on the ground, dealing 60 (+6 per minute) damage.
After 1 second, it explodes for 380 (+38 per minute) damage.
Due to its delay, Scorching Laser should generally be used to damage
enemy Structures (ideally 2-3 at the same time), however,
it can also be used on enemy Heroes who cannot move for about 1 second
because of crowd control effects.
!
How to use Vehicles
Vehicles have two resources: Health and duration.
If they time out with high Health, it means you played too safe.
If they get destroyed while there is still a lot of duration remaining,
it means you played too aggressive. As a general rule,
you want to keep the percentage values of Health and duration balanced.
When pushing with a won Objective, you should still avoid being
caught alone and not fight when outnumbered, especially when going for Keeps.
If your Vehicle gets destroyed deep in the enemy territory, you will not be
able to reach a safe area before getting killed unless you have a lot of
mobility.
In the early game, when multiple enemy Forts are still up, Vehicles can also
be used as a distraction, not just for pushing directly.
While they clear enemy Minions and threaten enemy Structures, the rest of
the team can push in another lane. The enemy team will have to split
for defending multiple lanes at the same time.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text:
Every 6 seconds, the Core shoots 3 Rocket Fists at nearby enemy Heroes,
dealing 150 damage and Knocking them back.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text:
To win the game on Volskaya Foundry, you should count on
any of the following win conditions:
Map Objective,
Split-push.
Try to store Turrets and Biotic Emitters for the late game.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text:
Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 1:00 minute
because the first Objective on this Map activates at 3:00 minutes,
so you will have it back in time for that.
Global Heroes should ideally take care
of the lane that is farther away from the next Objective location,
so that they can use their global tool
to quickly join their team during the next Objective phase.
We recommend to let a non-Healer pick the Biotic Emitter, so that
it can be used to heal the Healer if they
happen to be under crowd control
or to heal your team when your Healer is dead.
The pilot slot of the Triglav Protector should be filled with
a squishy Hero because leaving them outside
while durable Heroes (usually with crowd control
usable to peel) are inside would make your
backline vulnerable to dive.
The gunner slot of the Triglav Protector can either be filled
with another squishy Hero or left empty,
so that whoever is in danger can enter in it to protect themselves
from enemy damage. Note that taking damage does not interrupt
the channel to enter in it.
When piloting the Triglav Protector, you should generally use:
Charge [Q] to damage enemy Structures or to clear grouped enemy Minions;
Rocket Fist [W] to instantly kill enemy Minions
and/or to disable enemy Structures;
and Shield Emitter [E] to gain Armor while under
attack and/or to Shield allied Heroes.
In case of emergency, Rocket Fist [W] can be also used to peel
for your team, or to interrupt a powerful
stationary channeled Ability
(such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.).
When being the gunner in the Triglav Protector, you should generally use:
Particle Cannon [Q] to clear enemy Minions when they are grouped;
Gatling Cannon [W] to damage enemy Heroes when your other Abilities
are on cooldown (stop using it when they are usable again);
and Scorching Laser [E] to damage enemy Structures
and/or crowd controlled enemy Heroes.
Heroes with percent damage
(such as Drain Hope by Leoric) are the best
for defending from enemy Vehicles. In case that is your
Offlaner and it is early game,
you may want to send someone else to soak in the lane they left.
Remember that Cursed Bullet by Greymane
and Sleep Dart by Ana cannot hit Vehicles.
If your team has a Hero with a powerful Quest that requires hitting enemy Heroes
(for example Zul'jin),
you could let the enemy team get an early game
Triglav Protector to easily get Quest stacks while defending from it.
If your team is doing fine, you can store Turrets and Biotic Emitters
for the late game instead of using them
in the early game. If you are going to die,
however, place them on the ground before they kill you and steal them.
If the enemy team is not contesting the Objective and you step out
of the Capture Point, you get 26% additional progress. This means
you can leave the Capture Point at 74% progress and still get a Triglav Protector.
Similarly, if you want to wait for allied Heroes before getting a Triglav Protector,
you should leave the Capture Point before reaching 74% progress.
At high level of play it is common to completely ignore the Objective area
and get value elsewhere by pushing
because the Triglav Protector takes too much time to be unlocked
and can generally be defended without much difficulty, sometimes after
diving and killing whoever is outside of it.
See our Map Guides page for further information »
